_readme: Owner-extensible search engines for the Lewis/Clark web search (jobs/_lib/eo_websearch.py). Each entry: name; url with {q} (the URL-encoded query) and optional {year}; kind = html (result links read generically), rss (<item> entries), or json (give 'json': {items, title, url, snippet, date} as dotted paths); optional env (environment variables that must be set; reference them in url/headers as {ENV:NAME}), headers, host_only (keep only result links on these hosts), url_prefix (for ids that are not URLs), disabled. Built-ins live in ENGINES in eo_websearch.py; an entry here with the same name overrides it. Example: {"name": "searxng_example", "kind": "json", "url": "https://searx.example.org/search?q={q}&format=json", "json": {"items": "results", "title": "title", "url": "url", "snippet": "content"}}
